input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_document
actions.title: Create document
actions.description: Create a document in Google Docs
actions.help: Creates a new document with the specified title and content. Only text content is supported at this time. If no content is provided, a blank document will be created using the given title.

input.name: title
input.label: Document Title
input.hint: The title of the new document.

input.name: content
input.label: Document Content
input.hint: The initial content of the document. Only text content is supported at this time.

actions.name: get_document
actions.title: Get document
actions.description: Get a document by ID in Google Docs
actions.help: Retrieves the latest version of the specified document.

input.name: document_id
input.label: Document ID
input.hint: The ID of the document to retrieve. Can be found in the document URL. Document URL generally follows this format: https://docs.google.com/document/d/{DOCUMENT_ID}/edit .
